title: Measurability of a two-half-plane angle set
statement: For every real number $\alpha$, the set $\{\theta\in\mathbb R : \cos\theta\le 0 \text{ and } \cos(\theta-\alpha)\le 0\}$ is measurable.
replaced: For every real $\alpha$, the set $\{\theta\in\mathbb R:\cos\theta\le0\ \text{and}\ \cos(\theta-\alpha)\le0\}$ is Borel measurable.
